name: m5-backend-compressed
description: Frames in `m5-backend-ceiling` showed no allocation drop, and `m5-backend-readmaxs-prof` shows why: `MethodWriter.visitFrame` converts each internal name of an expanded frame to a descriptor and parses it back (87 MB/op), which the compressed path does not do. `readCompressedMaxs` gives the same frames compressed, for the real ceiling. `readFrames` and `readMaxs` repeat in this campaign so all three compare in one.
Upstream `2.13.x` at `c84dea8aa7`, built with the release optimizer settings; patched JDK 26, 8G heap.
